change: Add a bilingual approximate confirmation-time hint to the pending payment return area.

copy.zh_CN: 付款确认约需1分钟，请稍后刷新查看会员状态。
copy.en: Payment confirmation may take about a minute. Refresh shortly to check your membership.

refresh_behavior.details: Billing JavaScript only updates absolute deadline text and prevents duplicate form submission. Global scripts handle identity forms and playback progress. Player-specific refresh behavior is loaded only on the watch page. Payment status changes appear after a manual refresh or explicit original-payment recheck.

regression.coverage: Bilingual pending text; absence on paid, failed, full/partial refund, expired, quote and error views; existing PayPal original-order recheck behavior.

render_check.method: Actual return-route HTML exported from an isolated synthetic test, rendered with existing local assets in headless Chrome; all browser requests fulfilled in-process.
